key_facts: Driver Kimi Antonelli, car 12, Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team, was penalized during the 2026 British Grand Prix race.

plain_explanation:
Kimi Antonelli, driving for Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team, received a 5 second time penalty during the 2026 British Grand Prix race.

The penalty was given because car 12 left the track at Turn 6 on Lap 44 without a justifiable reason. This breached Article B1.8.6 of the FIA F1 Regulations, which governs track limits (the requirement to keep the car within the track boundaries).

This was Antonelli's fourth track limits infringement of the race. Even though the car was experiencing a mechanical issue at the time, the Stewards ruled that this did not provide a justifiable reason for leaving the track.

The 5 second time penalty is the standard penalty under the Penalty Guidelines for a fourth track limits infringement during a race.</explanation>
